text:
mia: Quick heads-up — thinking about running a 'micro-cinema gratitude cart' next week. Idea: roll a small popcorn cart between floors + hand out 3x physical spot-award cards and a short note template. Low-touch, pop-in recognition + treats. Would love sign-off on budget (popcorn + cards + printer) and a volunteer rota.
devon: Love it. Rough budget estimate? Also which days/offices?
mia: Ballpark: $120 for popcorn supplies (3 days), $40 for printing stock, $40 for a small novelty prize box = ~$200. Proposal: Tue/Wed/Thu next week, 11:30–1:30 rotating between 3 floors in SF office.
sam: Can we swap the novelty prize for stickers? cheaper and more inclusive. Also I can run Tue 11:30–12:30.
alejandro: Quick policy check — physical spot awards under $250 are non-taxable swag, but we should log recipients for recognition records. I'll need a simple spreadsheet with name, manager, date, and reason.
mia: Good call. I'll make a template. Suggest we pre-print 50 cards and have a blank field for reason.
devon: I'll sponsor printing. @ops-bot can you create a public calendar event for the rota?
ops-bot: Created calendar: "Micro-Cinema Gratitude Cart — SF" with tentative slots Tue 11:30, Tue 12:30, Wed 11:30, Wed 12:30, Thu 11:30, Thu 12:30. Link: https://calendar.company/internal/xxxx
sam: FYI — AV team said we can use the cart from hospitality. Need 24h notice. Mia, can you confirm pickup time?
mia: I'll email hospitality now. Also printing note: using the people-ops printer (floor 4). Devon — can you drop the paper there by Monday EOD?
devon: Yep, I'll drop 100 sheets of 110lb cardstock by 4pm Monday.
alejandro: For the tracking sheet, use this header: `date, recipient_name, recipient_email, manager, reason, card_serial` — will help tie to rewards system.
mia: Perfect. I'll attach a QR code on the cart that links to a tiny feedback form + opt-in to log the award (for those who prefer digital).
sam: I'm happy to cover Thu slot. Also bringing a small card-holder to keep cards tidy.
devon: Can we get a brief blurb for the all-hands email? One-liner + where/when and how to nominate someone quickly.
mia: Draft blurb: "Popcorn & recognition are coming to you next week — spot-award cards + popcorn cart touring floors Tue–Thu 11:30–1:30. Nominate a teammate on the spot or scan the QR to log a recognition. See calendar for shift signups." Thoughts?
alejandro: Add: "Awards are small tokens of appreciation; recipients are logged for recognition stats only." OK from compliance.
sam: +1. Maybe add :popcorn: emoji.
mia: Updated blurb with emoji and calendar link. I'll ping comms to include in Friday digest.
devon: Logistics checklist before Monday: hospitality confirm cart, print stock at printer, QR form live, spreadsheet created, calendar slots filled. Who owns final check?
mia: I'll own final check. I'll post a short readiness message Monday morning here and ping volunteers.
sam: Thanks! excited :) :popcorn:
alejandro: If anything changes on tax/value, I'll update you but looks good. Please keep receipts for reconciliation.
mia: Will do. Action items: devon -> drop paper; ops-bot -> keep calendar; sam -> Thu slot + card-holder; alejandro -> tracking schema + receipts note; mia -> hospitality, QR, blurb, final check.
ops-bot: Reminder set for Monday 09:00 to "Micro-Cinema Gratitude Cart final check".
devon: Done. See you all next week.
mia: Thanks team — closing thread once Monday check is green. :tada:
